name: Ransomware-Like Activity
description: Synthetic high-volume file modifications on an employee workstation with spreading risk toward the file server. No real ransomware — typed simulation events only.

attack_steps.description: Synthetic suspicious process starts on employee workstation
High-volume synthetic file modifications detected (240 files/min, synthetic)
Workstation attempts repeated connections to file server share
Synthetic file modifications begin appearing on shared drive

invariant: Suspicious workstation cannot reach the file server and containment is active
